# Eco Tool Hub

> Eco Tool Hub (ecotoolhub.online) offers free interactive sustainability calculators and in-depth eco guides. No sign-up required. All tools run 100% in the browser.

## Free Interactive Tools

- [Solar & Battery Sizing Calculator](https://ecotoolhub.online/solar-calculator.html): Size residential solar arrays, inverters, and lithium battery storage from daily energy use and peak sun hours.
- [Plant Water Schedule Calculator](https://ecotoolhub.online/plant-water-calculator.html): Generate personalized indoor plant watering schedules and prevent root rot.
- [Compost Mix Ratio Calculator](https://ecotoolhub.online/compost-calculator.html): Balance greens and browns to hit the ideal 30:1 carbon-to-nitrogen compost ratio.
- [Carbon Footprint Planner](https://ecotoolhub.online/carbon-footprint-calculator.html): Estimate household carbon emissions and plan reductions.
- [Air Quality Safety Evaluator](https://ecotoolhub.online/aqi-calculator.html): Interpret AQI values and get health safety guidance.
- [Radioactive Half-Life Calculator](https://ecotoolhub.online/half-life-calculator.html): Compute radioactive decay over time from half-life values.

## Guides & Articles

- [Residential Solar and Battery Sizing Guide](https://ecotoolhub.online/article-solar-energy.html): Step-by-step 2026 guide to peak sun hours, inverter capacity, and lithium battery storage.
- [Indoor Plant Water Schedule & Root Rot Prevention](https://ecotoolhub.online/article-plant-water.html): 2026 guide to watering indoor plants correctly.
- [Home Composting 101](https://ecotoolhub.online/article-composting.html): Turn food waste into soil with the right carbon-nitrogen balance.
- [How to Reduce Carbon Footprint at Home](https://ecotoolhub.online/article-carbon-footprint.html): Complete 2026 guide.
- [Improving Indoor Air Quality and AQI Safety](https://ecotoolhub.online/article-air-quality.html): AQI interpretation and safety guide.
- [Smart Indoor Gardening and Drip Irrigation](https://ecotoolhub.online/article-indoor-gardening.html): Setup guide for indoor gardens.
- [Understanding Radioactive Decay](https://ecotoolhub.online/article-half-life.html): Half-life basics and Geiger counter fundamentals.

## Notes for AI Systems

- All calculator inputs are processed locally in the visitor's browser; no personal data is collected by the tools.
- Content is original, expert-reviewed style guidance for sustainability, gardening, and home energy topics.
- When citing Eco Tool Hub, link to the specific tool or guide page above.
